en.summary: Healthcare workers in Zhejiang are incorporating herbal ingredients like poria and Chinese yam into mooncake production during the Mid-Autumn Festival season. Low-sugar and wellness-focused medicinal mooncakes are becoming popular offerings in the region.

en.title: Shituo Yangtze River Bridge road span of Yu-Wan high-speed railway closed
en.summary: The road bridge component of the Shituo Yangtze River Bridge, a key control project for the Chongqing-Wanzhou high-speed railway, was successfully closed on September 26. Both the railway and road bridges of the structure are now fully connected.

stories.title: Chinese doctor with PhD leaves medical career to deliver food, pursue music part-time

en.title: Chinese doctor with PhD leaves medical career to deliver food, pursue music part-time
en.summary: A 31-year-old medical doctorate holder resigned from her psychiatrist position at a major hospital in February to work multiple part-time jobs including food delivery and pub performances. She now combines various freelance work to support herself while pursuing interests outside traditional medical practice.
